description: This source file defines the internal class 'SiloConnection' which manages silo-to-silo network connections in Orleans Runtime. It handles message sending, receiving, ping responses, connection preamble, and error conditions within the silo networking infrastructure.

classes.name: SiloAddress
classes.description: Represents the address of a silo in Orleans topology.

classes.description: Base class for connection handling in Orleans transport layer.

classes.description: Represents network messages exchanged between silos.

classes.description: Handles message dispatch and processing within the silo.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: Manages lifecycle and tracking of connections.

classes.name: ProbeRequestMonitor
classes.description: Monitors incoming probe requests for liveness checks.

classes.name: ConnectionPreambleHelper
classes.description: Helps in reading and writing connection preamble data.
